units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 61b:4">B. Mets. 61ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>במדה</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 19:35">Lev. XIX, 35</cite>) <he>זו מְדִידַת קרקע</he> this refers to land-measuring. Pesik. Vayhi, p. 7ᵃ (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 26:6">Ex. XXVI, 6</cite> a.
<cite ref="Exodus 26:11">11</cite>) <he>אחד למ׳ וכ׳</he> one <he>וחברת</he> refers to the measuring (fitting), the other to anointing (the tabernacle after it is put up).
